findings.evidence: Current render reads as a low-contrast block; the reference has a clear 4u storefront, strong top fascia, projecting awning, and visible plinth.

recommendedChange.measurement: Increase fascia Z prominence by 20% (bounded scaleZ 1.0-1.2), awning Y projection by 25% (0.75u to 0.94u), and retain foundation step visibility.

findings.evidence: Fascia/sign and entrance do not dominate the facade as in the reference.

recommendedChange.measurement: Center sign on fascia; make fascia/sign occupy approximately 15-20% of facade height; keep door centered in its 1.25u x 2.25u module envelope.

findings.evidence: Window, awning, and fascia read smaller than the approved concept relative to the wall panel.

recommendedChange.measurement: Increase window visible area by 15% within its 1.25u x 1.75u module bounds; do not exceed registered dimensions or budget.

findings.evidence: Scalloped fabric edge and projection are not sufficiently readable from the locked review camera.

recommendedChange.measurement: Increase depth 25% from 0.75u to 0.94u and preserve segmented/scalloped lower edge; no new geometry.

findings.evidence: Navy fascia/sign contrast and vertical prominence are weak in the current render.

recommendedChange.measurement: Use shared navy material, keep sign insert centered, and increase fascia height by 20% within module transform limits.

findings.evidence: Teal window is present but does not carry enough visual weight.

recommendedChange.measurement: Increase visible width and height by 15% within registered module bounds; preserve teal glass and cream trim materials.

findings.evidence: Entrance readability is weak at gameplay scale.

recommendedChange.measurement: Keep door front-facing, align its center to the facade grid, and place the front plane at the registered storefront depth (approximately y=-0.25u); no geometry additions.

findings.evidence: Planter/shrub relationship is too small or visually detached from the storefront.

recommendedChange.measurement: Place the planter at the right-front storefront bay (x approximately 2.0-2.25u, y approximately -0.1u), keeping registered scale and green vegetation identity.

findings.evidence: Required palette families are registered; the next run must use only shared atlas materials.
